summary: The bank in {place} can handle payroll while its lobby is closed for ordinary business.
realLife: Roosevelt explained that the emergency banking rules made room for employers to pay workers.
gates: Payroll is due during a general bank closure.
weights: More employers depend on the closed bank for payroll.
inGame: needs: the payroll due date and bank closure exceptions.

turns.what: A neighboring bank handles the payroll.
turns.pulledBy: The employer already holds a second account.
turns.writesBack: The payment record names the other bank.

turns.what: Some checks arrive a day late.
turns.pulledBy: The payroll papers miss the processing cutoff.
turns.writesBack: The register separates paid and outstanding checks.
